source.described_commit_note: This packet binds the exact clean review-fix implementation commit; the packet itself is added by the following evidence commit.

scope: Close the three owner-adopted PR #8 review blockers: local-only live status routing, truthful live response failure classification, and AbortSignal listener cleanup in delayed mock requests.

l1_milestones: cross-cutting E1-B status shell (no milestone promotion claimed)
quality_mapping.track_2_relevance: Prevents arbitrary remote services or malformed responses from being presented as truthful local Agent status.
quality_mapping.submission_impact: Strengthens the trustworthiness of local-only browser evidence; no GPU or performance claim is added.

review_constraints.result: Browser live mode is fixed to same-origin /api; VITE_PROXY_TARGET accepts only loopback HTTP(S) origins and rejects remote/private-network/non-origin values.
HTTP, timeout, caller cancellation, network/body transport failure, invalid JSON, and incompatible HealthStatusV1 are classified separately and fail closed.
Delayed mock requests remove the exact registered abort listener on normal completion and cancellation and reject pre-cancelled signals.

environment.hardware: local developer workstation, arm64; no GPU used

commands.cmd: npm run verify:contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
commands.result: 15/15 provenance; TypeScript and ESLint passed; Vitest 9 files/89 tests; production build passed; Playwright 15 passed and 1 live test skipped without a live URL.

commands.cmd: bash -n scripts/*.sh && python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s qa/tests -v && bash qa/gates/pr_gate.sh --mode contract
commands.result: Repository shell/Python checks passed; public QA 31/31; PR contract gate passed.

commands.cmd: for trace in web/src/data/traces/*.json; do python3 qa/scripts/check_retrieval_phase.py $trace; done
commands.result: All 5 retained AC-30 traces passed; relation behavior was not changed.

retained_failures: The first proxy-target test imported vite.config.ts into a jsdom provider suite, violating esbuild's TextEncoder invariant and crossing the composite TS project boundary. The test moved to an explicit Node-environment Vite config suite; typecheck, lint, and 20/20 narrow tests then passed.

Independent review found that JSON-body timeout/cancellation could still be mislabeled invalid JSON. Classification moved to the outer request boundary and body-phase timeout/cancellation tests were added.

The first body-phase test advanced fake timers before response.json installed its abort listener and timed out. It was corrected to wait for body reading to start; the final narrow suite passed 21/21.
unverified: Post-push GitHub CI and owner re-review are pending.
The three GitHub review threads remain unresolved until the owner/reviewer accepts the pushed changes.
No live FastAPI E2E rerun was required by the latest owner review; the live test remained skipped without E2E_LIVE_BASE_URL.
W7900/ROCm/model viability and performance were not exercised or claimed.

privacy_review.notes: The diff and packet contain only source, synthetic tests, loopback/public URLs, commit identities, and aggregate results. No credential, private user content, raw trace, database, model weight, or private QA material is retained.

No dependency upgrade or npm audit fix --force.
No GPU, performance, E2+, publication, Ready/Draft, PR-body, or merge action.
